request.goal: Read the links I give it about a question and write a cited brief.
request.name: Cited brief

stages.name: Read the links
stages.why: Fetch each link you give and pull out what the page says about your question, keeping exact quotes and noting any page that fails to load.

stages.name: Write the brief
stages.why: Turn what the pages said into one brief that answers your question and cites every point by link and page, so you can check each claim back to its source.
